title: 1991 radio caller: underground work alongside alien-like beings
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 1991 radio caller: underground work alongside alien-like beings, about 1991 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Underground test site, Nevada (Las Vegas radio)

tellings.quote: 1991, a caller into a Las Vegas radio show claimed he was hired to run electricity 3,000 ft underground on a certain test site, a job that came through Reynolds Electronics, an EG subsidiary. [music] He also said that military personnel were working alongside beings that resembled aliens.

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels describes a call made in 1991 to a radio show in Las Vegas, Nevada. According to Michels, the caller said he had been hired through Reynolds Electronics, part of a company Michels calls EG, to run electrical lines 3,000 feet underground at a government test site. The caller also said that military staff down there worked side by side with beings that looked like aliens, which, if true, would mean the government is secretly working with non-human beings.
